mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance (member_id, attend_time, attend_date, status) values (#{memberId}, #{attendTime}, #{attendDate}, #{status}::attend_status)
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance SET note = #{note} WHERE attend_id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT member_id, attend_date, status, note from attendance WHERE attend_date = #{today}
select Count(*) AS totalCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'TIME_OUT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lateCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'MISS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS absentCnt from attendance WHERE member_id = #{id}
